public.how.title: Okuva ku lunaku lw'okusimba okutuuka ku mutendera
public.how.lead: Omutendera gutera okuyingizibwa na mukono era guba mupya okusinziira ku lwe gwasemba okuzzibwa obuggya. Wano gubalibwa okuva ku mbeera y'obudde eyawandiikibwa, era buli nkyukakyuka etereka obukakafu bwayo.
public.step.1.title: Wandiika omulimi ky'amanyi
public.step.1.body: Faamu, ennimiro, ebirime n'ennaku z'okusimba biterekebwa mu Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Ggyayo embeera y'obudde eyabaddewo
public.step.2.body: Ebbugumu lya buli lunaku ku kifo ky'ennimiro liggibwa mu byawandiikibwa bya Open-Meteo, okuva lwe kyasimbibwa okutuuka leero.
public.step.3.title: Gatta ennaku z'ebbugumu
public.step.3.body: Ennaku z'ebbugumu ezikuzza ekirime (GDD) zigattibwa okusinziira ku nkola y'ekirime. Bwe zituuka ku kipimo, enkola etwala sizoni ku mutendera oguddako era n'ewandiika ensonga.
public.models.title: Enkola z'ebirime ezikozesebwa
public.models.lead: Ennaku z'ebbugumu ezeetaagibwa ekirime okutuuka okukungulwa. Ebipimo bino byawandiikibwa na mukono era tebinnaba na bujulizi.
public.live.title: Embeera ku faamu ey'okulabirako e Swartland
public.live.lead: Ebipimo okuva mu nsonda ez'olukale, bizzibwa buggya buli ddakiika 30.

public.honesty.1.title: Amakungula gayingizibwa omukozi
public.honesty.1.body: Omukozi bw’aba tannawandiika makungula, app eraga “Tegannawandiikibwa”.
public.honesty.2.title: Ebibalo eby’okugerageranya biterekebwa byokka
public.honesty.2.body: Ebibalo by’ekitundu n’eggwanga biterekebwa mu biwandiiko byabyo, nga biriko ensibuko n’ekipimo. Tebigerageranyizibwa na makungula ga nnimiro.
public.honesty.3.title: Ebiwandiiko by’ebiwuka bya kitundu
public.honesty.3.body: Ebiwandiiko bya GBIF biraga ebiwuka ebyalabibwa mu buwanvu bwa km 100, n’obuwanvu we byalabibwa.
public.honesty.4.title: Obudde buva butereevu
public.honesty.4.body: Ebbugumu liggyibwa mu tterekero lya Open-Meteo buli lwe lisabibwa.
public.open.title: Ggulawo sizoni
public.open.body: Yingira mu demo olabe ennyiriri za GDD eza sizoni n’obukakafu obulaga omutendera gwayo.

public.about.title: Ebikwata ku
public.about.heading: Ebikwata ku Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis ye nkola egoberera ennimiro n’ebirime ku faamu y’e Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Lwaki eriwo
public.about.why.body: Emitendera gy’ennimiro gikaddiwa, ate amakungula gawandiikibwa nga basinziira ku kujjukira. Mecropolis ebalirira omutendera ng’esinziira ku budde obwawandiikibwa. Buli muwendo guva ku mukozi oba ku nsibuko ya bonna eriko erinnya.
public.about.design.title: Enteekateeka
public.about.design.1.body: Ennaku z’ebbugumu ez’okukula zibalibwa okuva ku lunaku lw’okusimba, nga bakozesa etterekero lya Open-Meteo. Buli mutendera bwe gukyuka, obukakafu bwagwo buterekebwa: olunaku lwe gwatandika, omugatte gwa GDD n’ebyo kwe gwabalirirwa.
public.about.design.2.body: Omutendera oguddako oluvannyuma lw’okutegekera amakungula guyitibwa okwengera olw’ebbugumu, kubanga tewali makungula gawandiikiddwa.
public.about.design.4.body: Biterekebwa mu biwandiiko byabyo nga biriko ensibuko, ekipimo ne layisinsi.
public.about.stack.title: Tekinologiya akozesebwa
public.about.stack.body: App ya lupapula lumu eya Vite ne React 19 eri ku Cloudflare Pages. Browser esoma butereevu ebikwata ku bonna ebya Sanity ng’ekozesa GROQ n’omuwuliriza w’enkyukakyuka ez’amangu. Ebiwandiikibwa n’ebikwata ku bisumuluzo biyita mu Cloudflare Pages Functions, ezikebera cookie ya session eriko omukono. Zod ekozesebwa ku biyingira n’ebifuluma, Vitest ku kugezesa, ate Tailwind 4 ku ndabika.
public.about.limits.title: Ebikyabulamu
public.about.limits.1: Emiwendo gy’ekirime (ebbugumu ery’okusinziirako, ebbugumu eryetaagisa okumera n’okwengera) gyateekebwawo na mukono era teginnaba na nsibuko.
public.about.limits.2: Ekipimo kya lupin kiva mu HarvestStat eky’emyaka 2000 okutuuka 2007 gyokka, era okuteekamu ebikwata ku ntandikwa tekwafuna biwandiiko bya lupin eby’okugerageranya.
public.about.limits.3: Ebikwata ku biwuka bye biwandiiko bya GBIF eby’ebiwuka ebyalabibwa okumpi ne faamu. Biraga ekifo ekika ky’ekiwuka we kyawandiikibwa okumpi ne faamu.
public.about.limits.4: Demo erina akawunti emu bonna gye bakozesa n’ekikugira okusaba emirundi mingi ekiterekebwa mu kujjukira kwa kompyuta. Okuyingira kukweka empapula z’awafugirwa naye tekukuuma bikwata ku faamu: buli muntu asobola okubisoma. Naye kukuuma buli kiwandiikibwa.

docs.stages.title: Enkola y’emitendera
docs.stages.guards: Buli kuva ku mutendera okudda ku mulala kulina ebisaanyizo. Omutendera gw’okusimbibwa gwetaaga olunaku lw’okusimba n’ekirime; ogw’okukula gwetaaga ekkomo ly’ebbugumu ery’okumera mu nnaku z’ebbugumu; ogw’okutegekera amakungula gwetaaga 90% ku kkomo ly’okwengera; ogw’okwengera olw’ebbugumu gwetaaga okutuuka ku kkomo ly’okwengera; ogw’okwekenneenya gwetaaga ekifaananyi ky’obudde bwa sizoni n’ekipimo eky’okugerageranya ekikakasiddwa. Ebisaanyizo bya GDD era byetaaga ebikwata ku bbugumu okumala waakiri 90% ku kiseera ekyo, era okukyuka okulina olunaku olutannatuuka kukugirwa.

docs.seed.body: {0} eteeka faamu ey'okulabirako, ennimiro, ebirime ne sizoni mu tterekero ly'oteeseteese, era n'etuukanya ebipimo by'ekitundu. Ezzaawo faamu, ennimiro n'ebirime, kale gikozese ku tterekero lyo lyokka.
guide.title: Engeri y'okukozesa Mecropolis
guide.lead: Ebiragiro ebimpi mu bigambo ebyangu. Bikubuulira app ky'ekola, baani abagikozesa, n'ebitundu byayo byonna kye bikola.
guide.what.title: Mecropolis kye ki
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis ekulondoola ennimiro n'ebirime bya faamu. Ebalirira ekirime we kituuse ng'egatta ebbugumu lye kifunye okuva lwe kyasimbibwa. Era ekulaga obudde, ettaka n'ebiramu eby'obulabe ebiriraanye faamu yo mu kifo kimu.
guide.what.p2: Yakolebwa ku lwa faamu z'omu Western Cape mu South Africa, naye enkola eno esobola okukozesebwa ku faamu yonna, mu kitundu kyonna ne mu sizoni yonna.
guide.who.title: Baani abagikozesa
guide.who.p1: Ya muntu alabirira ennimiro, ng'omulimi, omuddukanya faamu oba omuwi w'amagezi.
guide.who.p2: Teweetaaga kumanya bya kompyuta oba bya budde. Bw'oba osobola okuggulawo omukutu, osobola okukozesa Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Lwaki ogikozesa
guide.why.1: Olaba mangu ebirime ebyaakasimbibwa, ebikula n'ebinaatera okwengera.
guide.why.2: Teweetaaga kutereeza buli nnimiro n'engalo, kubanga app etwala ekirime mu mutendera oguddako obudde bwe bulaga nti ekiseera kituuse.
guide.why.3: Ekutegeeza ku mbeho ey'ekisukiridde n'ebbugumu mu nnaku entono ezijja, ne ku biramu eby'obulabe ebirabiddwa okumpi ne faamu yo.
guide.why.4: Byonna ebiwandiikiddwa ku nnimiro, ng'okufuuyira, ekiramu eky'obulabe kye walaba oba ekiwandiiko, bikuumibwa wamu n'olunaku lwabyo osobole okubiraba oluvannyuma.
guide.why.5: Buli muwendo gulaga gye gwava, omanye kye weesiga.
guide.heat.title: App emanya etya ekirime we kituuse
guide.heat.p1: Ebirime bikula mangu nga wabuguma, ne bikula mpola nga bunnyogovu. Mecropolis ebala ebbugumu lino buli lunaku mu bipimo by'ebbugumu, bannassaayansi bye bayita growing degree days oba GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Buli lunaku etwala wakati w'ebbugumu erisinga n'erisinga obutono, n'eggyako ebbugumu ekirime kwe kirekera okukula. Ekisigala kye kipimo ky'ebbugumu eky'olunaku olwo. Olunaku olw'obunnyogovu terwongerako kantu.
guide.heat.p3: Buli kirime kyetaaga omugatte gw'ebipimo by'ebbugumu ogugere nga tekinnaba kwengera. Omugatte okuva lwe kyasimbibwa bwe gusembera ku muwendo ogwo, ekirime kiyita mu mutendera oguddako.
guide.heat.p4: Ebipimo by'ebbugumu biva ku Open-Meteo, empeereza y'obudde ey'obwereere ekuuma obudde bw'ebifo byonna ku nsi.
guide.stages.title: Emitendera omukaaga
guide.stages.intro: Buli kirime mu buli nnimiro kiyita mu mitendera gino nga bwe girondeddwa.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Ekirime kifunye kumpi ebbugumu lyonna lye kyetaaga, kale kye kiseera okwetegekera okukungula.
guide.stages.harvested: Ekirime kifunye ebbugumu lyonna lye kyetaaga, kale kyandibadde kyengedde. Ggwe wekka asobola okukakasa nti kyakunguddwa, kale app ekiyita okwengera olw'ebbugumu.
guide.stages.review: Sizoni ewedde era osobola okwetegereza bwe yatambula.
guide.stages.p2: App ekebera buli kirime buli kiro, era ne buli muntu lw'agattako ky'alabye oba omulimu gw'akoze. Osobola n'okunyiga Reconcile now ku sizoni okukikebera amangu.
guide.start.title: Okutandika
guide.start.1: Ggulawo olupapula olusooka. Osobola okulaba maapu y'obudde, ettaka, ebiramu eby'obulabe n'amakungula ga faamu ey'okulabirako nga tonnayingira.
guide.start.2: Nyiga Sign in waggulu, okozese ebikwata ku akawunti ey'okulabirako bye wakuweebwa.
guide.start.3: Londako faamu. Kino kiggulawo awafunzirwa ebya faamu eyo.
guide.start.4: Nyiga ku sizoni olabe byonna ebikwata ku kirime ekyo mu nnimiro eyo.
guide.start.5: Kozesa akasanduuko k'olulimi waggulu ku buli lupapula okukyusa olulimi. App ejjukira ky'olonze bw'oddamu okugikozesa.
guide.home.title: Olupapula olusooka
guide.home.p1: Olupapula olusooka lulaga maapu y'ekitundu eriko langi okusinziira ku bbugumu ettaka lye lifunye sizoni eno. Era lulaga obudde obuliwo n'obw'ennaku entono ezijja, ettaka lya faamu ey'okulabirako, ebiramu eby'obulabe ebirabiddwa okumpi gye buvuddeko, n'amakungula aga bulijjo mu kitundu. Teweetaaga kuyingira okubiraba.
guide.dashboard.title: Awafunzirwa ebya faamu
guide.dashboard.intro: Awafunzirwa walaga faamu emu. Bino bye bitundu byawo okuva waggulu okutuuka wansi. Akasanduuko ka faamu waggulu kakuyamba okugenda ku faamu endala.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Mu bufunze ebya faamu
guide.dashboard.summary: Omuwendo gw'ennimiro ne ha faamu z'erina, sizoni ezitambula n'ebirime ebyengedde.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Ebyetaaga okukolebwako
guide.dashboard.alerts: Okulabula okumpi, ng'embeho ey'ekisukiridde oba ebbugumu ebiri mu kuteebereza, ekirime ekyengedde, sizoni etatandise mu budde, oba ebiramu eby'obulabe ebirabiddwa okumpi n'ennimiro. Buli kulabula kulaga ekyakuleese.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Embeera ya faamu
guide.dashboard.conditions: Obudde bwa leero, obuteebereza, ettaka n'ebiramu eby'obulabe ebiriraanye faamu eno.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Sizoni we etuuse
guide.dashboard.progress: Kaadi ya buli kirime eraga ebbugumu lye kimaze okugatta. Osobola okugeraageranya ennimiro, n'owanula olukalala nga fayiro y'emmeeza (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Ennimiro
guide.dashboard.fields: Buli nnimiro ku faamu, obunene bwayo, ettaka lyayo n'ebirime byayo.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Noonya mu biwandiiko
guide.dashboard.search: Wandiika ky'onoonya mu bigambo ebya bulijjo, ng'obuwuka bwa aphids ku ŋŋaano. Ezuula bye walaba n'emirimu egyakolebwa ebitegeeza kye kimu, ne bwe biba bikozesa ebigambo ebirala.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Amagezi
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Emirimu egiteeseddwa ku nnimiro, ng'okufuuyira oba okuteekamu ebigimusa. Osobola okukkiriza oba okugaana buli gumu, n'okugulamba nti guwedde nga gumaliriziddwa.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Ebyaakakolebwa
guide.dashboard.activity: Olukalala lw'ebiseera buli kirime lwe kyayita mu mutendera omupya.
guide.season.title: Olupapula lwa sizoni
guide.season.intro: Sizoni kye kirime kimu mu nnimiro emu mu mwaka gumu. Olupapula lwayo luliko byonna ebikikwatako.
guide.season.top.label: Waggulu ku lupapula
guide.season.top: Ekirime, ennimiro, olunaku lw'okusimba, olunaku lw'okukungula olusuubirwa n'amakungula ng'omaze okugayingiza.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Emitendera gya sizoni
guide.season.pipeline: Emitendera omukaaga nga oguliwo gulambiddwa. Nyiga Reconcile now okukeberebwa amangu oba ekirime kirina okugenda ku mutendera oguddako.
guide.season.readiness.label: Ebyetaagisa okusalawo
guide.season.readiness: Olukalala lw'ebyo app by'etaaga nga tennatwala kirime mu mutendera oguddako, ng'olunaku lw'okusimba n'ebikwata ku budde ebimala. Buli kimu kiraga Pass, Warning oba Blocked; ekiziyiziddwa kikubuulira ekibulawo.
guide.season.evidence.label: Obukakafu
guide.season.evidence: Ebiwandiiko app bye yakozesa okusalawo, osobole okubikebera.
guide.season.propose.label: Teesa omulimu
guide.season.propose: Teesa omulimu ku nnimiro eno ng'obukakafu bwa sizoni bugattiddwako. Gusigala nga gwa kuteesa okutuusa omuntu lw'agukkiriza ku wafunzirwa.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Kifaananyi ekiraga ebipimo by'ebbugumu nga byeyongera okuva lwe kyasimbibwa, n'omusittale ogulaga omugatte ekirime gwe kyetaaga.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Watya singa?
guide.season.whatIf: Gezaako olunaku lw'okusimba olusooka oba oluddirira, oba sizoni ey'ebbugumu oba ey'obunnyogovu, olabe ebipimo by'ebbugumu bwe byandikyuse. Tewali kikuumibwa.
guide.season.summary.label: Mu bufunze ebya sizoni
guide.season.summary: Mu bufunze ebiwandiiko bya sizoni ebikoleddwa AI. Bikozese ng'obuyambi, era kebera ebiwandiiko bwe wabaawo ekirabika nga kikyamu.
guide.season.notes.label: Ebiwandiiko bya sizoni
guide.season.notes: Ebiwandiiko bya sizoni ebiriko ennaku. Osobola okubigattako, okubikyusa n'okubisangula, era n'okuzzaawo ekiwandiiko eky'edda.
guide.season.files.label: Ekifaananyi ky'ennimiro ne lipoota y'okukebera ettaka
guide.season.files: Teekako ekifaananyi ky'ennimiro ne PDF ya lipoota y'okukebera ettaka okuva mu lab.
guide.season.log.label: Ebiwandiiko by'ennimiro
guide.season.log: Bye walaba mu nnimiro n'ebyo bye wagikola, ng'okufuuyira n'eddagala lye wakozesa n'ekipimo kyalyo.
guide.season.history.label: Ebyakyusibwa
guide.season.history: Buli nkyukakyuka ekuumiddwa ku sizoni eno n'olunaku lwayo.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Ekipimo ky'ekitundu
guide.season.benchmark: Amakungula aga bulijjo mu kitundu okuva mu bibalo bya bonna. Ga kugeraageranya, si ge makungula g'ennimiro yo.
guide.season.pests.label: Ebiramu eby'obulabe ebirabiddwa mu kitundu
guide.season.pests: Ebiramu eby'obulabe ebirabiddwa okumpi n'ennimiro ne biteekebwa ku GBIF, etterekero lya bonna ery'ebirabiddwa. Nyiga Fetch sightings okufuna ebipya.
guide.sources.title: Emiwendo gye giva
guide.sources.weather: Obudde buva ku Open-Meteo, obwa leero, obuteebereza n'obw'ennaku eziyise.
guide.sources.soil: Ebikwata ku ttaka biva ku SoilGrids, maapu y'ettaka ly'ensi yonna.
guide.sources.pests: Ebiramu eby'obulabe ebirabiddwa biva ku GBIF, etterekero lya bonna ery'ebirabiddwa.
guide.sources.yields: Amakungula g'ekitundu gava ku USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa ne World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Ebirala byonna, ng'ebiwandiiko, emirimu egyakolebwa n'amakungula go, bye ggwe oba ttiimu yo bye mwayingiza.
guide.limits.title: By'etasobola kukola
guide.limits.model: Ebipimo by'ebbugumu buli kirime bye kyetaaga bya kuteebereza kwaffe era tebinnagezesebwa mu nnimiro. Bikozese ng'obulagirizi, naye weesige ky'olaba mu nnimiro yo.
guide.limits.maturity: Okukula okusinziira ku bbugumu kitegeeza nti embeera y'obudde eraga nti ekirime kyandibadde kituuse okukungulwa. Ggwe wekka y'omanyi oba ddala kituuse.
guide.limits.translation: Enkyusa zino zaawandiikibwa AI. Ziteekwa okuba ennyangu okutegeera, naye tewali mwogezi wa Luganda yakebera buli lulimi.
guide.limits.demo: Ekyokulabirako kino buli muntu asobola okukikozesa, kale tossangamu bya kyama.
